title: Everyday sign-in and signing out
summary: Use your password and authenticator, correct common mistakes, switch users, and return after a session ends.
scenes: End your session and return safely

steps.say: Enter your MERIT user name and password. Check the user name if you share a workstation; each person uses their own account.
A wrong user name or password gives the same message. Check typing and Caps Lock. If you cannot remember the password, use Forgot your password.
onScreen: The user name or password is not right.

steps.say: Correct the password and choose Continue. A correct password takes you to the verification step, not directly into MERIT.
Wrong person? Choose Sign in as a different user to return to the password screen, then start with the right account.
actions: Selects “Sign in as a different user”

steps.say: Sign in again. Open the MERIT entry in your authenticator app and use its current six-digit code. The app works without receiving a text message.
onScreen: Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required. · Six-digit code from your authenticator app * · Or enter one of your ten-character recovery codes. · Verify and sign in

steps.say: A mistyped or old code is rejected. Wait for the next code, check your phone time, and use the entry for this MERIT account.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from your authenticator app (hidden)
onScreen: That code did not work. Enter the current code from your authenticator app, or choose Can't access your authenticator? for help.

steps.say: Enter the current code and choose Verify and sign in. MERIT returns you to the page you requested, when your access permits it.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from your authenticator app (hidden)

steps.say: Check your name and active profile in the header. The profile determines which records and tools are available after sign-in.
onScreen: MERIT · Metals Exposure Registry and Investigation Tracking · Home · Work queues · People · Intake · Surveillance · Registry & reports · Administration · Search people, cases and accession numbers · Search · Robin Return · MERIT Sign-in Training (demo) · Profile · Master profile · Switch ▾ · : switch profile or jurisdiction · User guide · (opens in a new tab) · Sign-in methods · Sign out

steps.say: Choose Sign out when you finish, especially on a shared computer. MERIT returns to the sign-in page and ends this session.
If your session expires or an administrator ends it, sign in again. You still need your password and second factor.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from your authenticator app (hidden)

steps.say: Use the normal two steps to return. If sign-in succeeds but you lack the access you need, check your profile or ask your administrator.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from your authenticator app (hidden)
onScreen: Profile · Master profile · Switch ▾ · : switch profile or jurisdiction
